title: OL-20261115-13: GAP-BOOTSTRAP-QACCT: bootstrap deploys to the target Cloudflare account with no person's session (workers#181)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** driver order
**Done check:** grep:deploy/cloudflare-accounts.json::"state": "running"
**Status:** open

Moved from ultrastable/workers#181 (DRAIN-FLEET-1). Bootstrap must deploy to the named target account through a server-side credential, never a local wrangler OAuth session. Closes with the account cutover (platformaudit flags 'cloudflare cutover').
